messages:
anna: Planning to run the quiet-window deploy tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Main goals: drain router connections, backfill KV cache, and pin API/runtime/console versions before traffic fanout. Any blockers?

bryan: +1. Do we have a pinned runtime artifact ready? I thought the q2-rt-optim build was still baking.

anna: We have q2-rt-optim:2026-03-18-rc3 pinned for canary. Will hold global traffic until canary passes.

sasha: Router needs a graceful drain script tweak — current drain timeout 45s might not be enough for active sessions. Proposing 90s.

leo: 90s sounds fine. Need to coordinate with console so web sockets don't drop unexpectedly. Maria, can console tolerate a 90s drain?

maria: Console team ok with 90s for the window. We'll show a banner to users. Also will enable an opt-in debug flag for session handoff.

deploy-bot: @channel canary deployment scheduled: service=runtime artifact=q2-rt-optim:2026-03-18-rc3 target=runtime-canary-3 window=02:00-02:20 UTC. Rollout policy=5% -> 25% if health ok.

anna: Good. Checklist to confirm before canary:
- pin API to api-v1.14.2
- pin runtime to q2-rt-optim:2026-03-18-rc3
- router drain timeout=90s and prewarm backends
- console banner + session-handshake flag on
- run smoke tests / golden prompts set

bryan: Add: make sure KV backfill job is queued but paused until after canary success. Backfill can spike i/o.

sasha: Agreed. Backfill job config snippet:```yaml
job: kv-backfill
parallelism: 8
 max_retries: 2
throttle_qps: 120
```

leo: For rollback criteria, propose immediate rollback if 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m or average p95 latency >600ms for 3m. Thoughts?

maria: Also watch console websocket reconnect rate >2% as a canary signal.

anna: Ack. I'll add those to the runbook and the deploy bot health checks. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/release/runbooks/quiet-window-2026-03-18

deploy-bot: Preflight results:
- api pinned: api-v1.14.2 ✅
- runtime image available in registry ✅
- router config diff: drain_timeout: 45 -> 90 ✅
- console banner draft ✅
- smoke tests baseline stored at s3://redwood-smoke/2026-03-17 ✅

bryan: One more: cross-service schema rev - are we doing a soft-forward on the API? The new runtime returns metadata header `x-rt-features` that older router should ignore. Confirm router compatibility.

sasha: Router already ignores unknown headers in v2. No change needed. Confirmed with unit test.

anna: Schedule: 01:45 UTC dry-run in staging, 02:00 start canary, 02:20 evaluate, 02:30 start gradual fanout, 02:50 full traffic. Quiet window ends 03:00.

leo: I'll be on call. If rollback triggered, who issues the rollback? Who's primary?

anna: Ops runbook: primary oncall (leo) executes rollback via deploy-bot rollback command; secondary is bryan for runtime rollback and sasha for router pin revert.

oncall-bot: Reminder: leo is on-call for this change. Paging plan set.

maria: I'll update release notes draft with console changes and the session-handshake instructions: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-18-quiet-window-draft.md

bryan: Quick note for logs: add these two fields to correlation id logs before traffic fanout: `trace_id` and `deploy_wave`. Helps rolling back to specific canary wave.

anna: Added to preflight. Also adding a short smoke-suite: `smoke.canary.basic`, `smoke.canary.latency`, `smoke.canary.ws`.

deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime-canary-3 wave=1 02:00:05 UTC. Monitoring hooks enabled.

leo: Observability check: no 5xx spikes at wave=1, p95=210ms, websocket reconnect 0.2%. Proceed to wave=2.

deploy-bot: Rolling out wave=2 -> 25% 02:12:30 UTC.

bryan: Backfill job queued but paused. Will kick after full traffic unless we see need.

sasha: Router drained and prewarmed. Drain logs: `connections_drained=124, wait=83s` — minor tail but expected.

maria: Console banner live in canary region. Users see maintenance banner for 4% of sessions. No error reports so far.

leo: wave=2 metrics stable. p95=220ms, 5xx=0.06%, ws_reconnect=0.4% -> within thresholds. Proceeding to full fanout in 10m.

deploy-bot: Rolling out to full: target=runtime all nodes 02:40:10 UTC.

bryan: Full rolled out. Starting KV backfill with throttling in 5m. Will monitor i/o.

maria: Release notes published draft -> https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-18-quiet-window.md : includes notes on pinned versions, router drain change, console banner, and known post-deploy tasks.

anna: Great work team. Post-deploy checklist: confirm backfill finished, monitor cost, snapshot perf baselines. If anything anomalous, revert by running: `deploy-bot rollback runtime q2-rt-optim:2026-03-18-rc2`

leo: Will stay on watch for next 60m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Change window closed 03:00 UTC. Automated ticket update posted.
